brief_summary: Two-panel bar chart. Top panel, zoomed to 0-20ms, compares wired, 2.4GHz dongle, and Bluetooth input latency ranges. Bottom panel, scaled to 0-250ms, shows the same three connection types compressed into a near-zero cluster against an amber bar marking human reaction time, visualizing the article's point that all three sit well under perceptible reaction time.
